decisions.reason: The trailing 译： credit is zh-CN translation-layer metadata, not an original game music credit; remove it while preserving the verified Latin creator name already present.

Creator credits remain in CJK and the item also carries a zh-CN translator credit. Manual audit requires verified Latin/Roman spellings for real creator names and forbids propagating unverified bridge translator metadata; embedded evidence is insufficient to reconstruct all names safely.
Real creator names are still CJK-only. Manual audit requires verified Latin/Roman spellings; no embedded authoritative romanization is available for these credits.
The creator name 俊龍 is CJK-only while creator credits require a verified Latin/Roman spelling. The batch contains no authoritative romanization, so guessing is not allowed.
Both creator names are CJK-only. Manual audit requires verified Latin/Roman spellings and the embedded batch provides no authoritative mapping.
